text: This horror demo shipped with Python inside it. And a machine learning runtime.

text: In a game about noticing when something has changed.

text: Let's do the game first, because this one is worth explaining.

text: Compartment six six six is an anomaly hunt. You wake up on a train with no memory of boarding it, and the only way forward is through the carriages.
sub: COMPARTMENT 666 is an anomaly hunt. You wake up on a train with no memory of boarding it, and the only way forward is through the carriages.

text: You walk into a compartment. You look at it. Then you decide one thing: is this normal, or has something changed.
sub: You walk into a compartment. You look at it. Then you decide one thing: is this normal, or has something changed.

text: Say normal when it's normal, and the train moves on. Say it wrong, either way, and you lose a life. You get three.

text: If you've played Exit eight, you know the shape of this. It's the loop that game turned into a genre: same room, again and again, and the only skill is noticing.
sub: If you've played Exit 8, you know the shape of this. It's the loop that game turned into a genre: same room, again and again, and the only skill is noticing.

text: What this one adds is a radio. A little handheld device that picks up anomalies you can't see, and you don't get to use it forever.
sub: What this one adds is a radio. A little handheld device that picks up anomalies you can't see, and you don't get to use it forever.

text: The dressing is an early 1900s express. Red velvet, oil paintings, brass. Which is a smart choice, because a period carriage is full of objects you don't have a memory for.
sub: The dressing is an early 1900s express. Red velvet, oil paintings, brass. Which is a smart choice, because a period carriage is full of objects you don't have a memory for.

text: And the anomalies are graded easy, medium and hard, with a different death animation waiting when you get one wrong.

text: So. One point four eight gigabytes, thirty six files.

text: Then I looked at the executable, and it isn't called what you'd expect.

text: The launcher is COMPARTMENT_666 dot exe. But the actual binary, the hundred and forty megabyte one, is called Unreal Game Win sixty-four Shipping.

text: That's Unreal's default. Every other Unreal demo I've opened renamed it. This project never did.

text: Three episodes ago Square Enix shipped that exact file. Same file, same reason: nobody tightened the shipping config.
